# Tulasi Healthcare

> > Tulasi Healthcare is a leading psychiatric hospital and rehabilitation center in Delhi NCR, India, providing comprehensive mental health and de-addiction treatment services.

Tulasi Healthcare specializes in treating complex psychiatric conditions including schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, OCD, depression, and dementia through evidence-based therapies and 24/7 clinical care. The organization serves patients across India and internationally, combining psychiatric expertise with rehabilitation programs and cognitive behavioral therapy.
